_comment: South Carolina 2026 QAP (signed 30 December 2025) Section IV Threshold Participation Criteria, pp.8-17. One row per lettered item; IV.E and IV.K are not itemised. The Appendix C1 set-aside and size requirements are not itemised.

criteria.heading: Required Documentation (market study and others)
criteria.quote: Applications must include the following documentation.

criteria.heading: Site Control, Ground Leases, and Scattered Sites
criteria.quote: An application must include one of the following documents executed by a Principal:

criteria.heading: Zoning
criteria.quote: Applications must include proof of proper zoning being in place at the time of application submission

criteria.heading: Wetlands and Environmental
criteria.quote: A map regarding the presence or absence of wetlands, including non-jurisdictional wetlands.

criteria.heading: Required Development Experience
criteria.quote: In order to participate in the LIHTC program, the proposed owner

criteria.heading: Required Management Experience
criteria.quote: The Application must identify the proposed management entity for the development at the time of full

criteria.heading: Required Capacity
criteria.quote: The Authority will assess the financial capacity of the individuals and/or entities proposed as managing

criteria.heading: Appraisals
criteria.quote: Applications must include a commercial real estate appraisal identifying the Authority as an authorized user

criteria.heading: Mandatory Site Requirements
criteria.quote: The Authority may reject a site based on information submitted in the application, site review findings

criteria.heading: Market Requirements
criteria.quote: Proposed developments must be economically viable as justified by the market study findings

criteria.heading: Targeting, Public Housing Agency Waiting Lists, and Average Income
criteria.quote: The Application must state whether the development will target families or older persons

criteria.heading: Mandatory Design Criteria
criteria.quote: Projects must comply with the applicable minimum design requirements, in Appendix B.

criteria.heading: Rehabilitation minimum
criteria.quote: The PNA for rehabilitation projects must show a minimum of $50,000 per unit in hard construction costs

criteria.heading: Financial Underwriting
criteria.quote: In determining financial feasibility, the Authority will disregard all personal or other guarantees
